model: full archival node; 365-day year; Gregorian month lengths with February fixed at 28 days

small_media.label: SMALL-MEDIA
small_media.weighting: Assumed production mix: 70% compact raster/PNG or text memes, 30% small JPEG/WebP

representative_corpus.label: REPRESENTATIVE CORPUS
representative_corpus.weighting: Empirical equal-weight Task 7.7 image-focused corpus (36 fixtures); not a forecast upload mix

large_media.label: LARGE-MEDIA
large_media.weighting: Assumed production mix: 80% 1.2-2 MiB image memes and 20% 512 KiB images; pessimistic image-heavy / little extra compression

storage.database_maintenance: Daily checkpoint assumed; quarterly VACUUM requires a second primary-sized working copy. Future v3 layout is modeled, not measured.

minimal.description: Monthly full SQLite-consistent backup, retain two; one local snapshot.

recommended.description: Weekly full SQLite-consistent backup, retain four; one local snapshot. No unsupported incremental backup assumed.

conservative.description: Weekly full SQLite-consistent backup, retain twelve; two local snapshots. No unsupported incremental backup assumed.

compute.assumption: 7.6C/7.6D isolated-worker p95 adversarial single-block total is provisional; it is not end-to-end throughput validation.

budget_vps.label: Budget VPS-style (illustrative Hetzner-class)
budget_vps.pricing_status: Illustrative USD-normalized assumption; check region/currency before purchase.

mainstream_cloud.label: Mainstream cloud (illustrative AWS Lightsail-class)
mainstream_cloud.pricing_status: Illustrative USD assumption; regional bundle, transfer allowance, and disk prices must be quoted before purchase.

storage_focused.label: Storage-focused node + object backup (illustrative)
storage_focused.pricing_status: Illustrative blended host/object-store assumption; B2 source is for backup storage, not a full-node host quote.
